labels.name: create_monitor
labels.description: Create a persistent monitor that tracks a URL, pricing page, package version, endpoint status, vendor claim, or custom keyword pattern over time. Monitors run automatically on their configured schedule (hourly/daily/weekly) via the Cloudflare cron trigger, or on demand with run_monitor_now. Results

labels.name: list_monitors
labels.description: List all monitors owned by this API key, with last run status and schedule. Requires a free watch key or paid API key.

labels.name: run_monitor_now
labels.description: Immediately run a monitor's verification check outside its normal schedule. Records the result and returns whether the observed value changed since the last run. Counts against your monthly quota. Requires a free watch key or paid API key.

labels.name: get_monitor_result
labels.description: Retrieve the most recent run results for a monitor, including change details, confidence score, evidence URLs, and any error information. Requires a free watch key or paid API key.

labels.name: delete_monitor
labels.description: Permanently delete a monitor and all its stored results. This action cannot be undone. Requires a free watch key or paid API key.

labels.name: generate_change_report
labels.description: Generate a summary report of monitor activity for a time window. Shows monitors run, changes detected, failures, risk levels, and recommended follow-up actions. Requires a free watch key or paid API key.

labels.name: create_share_link
labels.description: Create a read-only public link to the latest result for one of your monitors. The link contains monitor metadata and evidence, never the API key, and expires automatically. Use it to share a verified change with a teammate, customer, or agent. Requires a free watch key or paid API key.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_endpoint, check_pricing, verify_claim, test_hypothesis, get_monitor_result · Private data: list_resources, list_monitors, run_monitor_now, get_monitor_result, delete_monitor, generate_change_report, create_share_link · Public sink: check_endpoint, estimate_market, create_share_link · Destructive: preflight_endpoint, check_pricing, test_hypothesis, create_monitor, list_monitors, run_monitor_now, get_monitor_result, delete_monitor, generate_change_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_endpoint, check_pricing, verify_claim, test_hypothesis, get_monitor_result · Private data: list_resources, list_monitors, run_monitor_now, get_monitor_result, delete_monitor, generate_change_report, create_share_link · Public sink: check_endpoint, estimate_market, create_share_link · Destructive: preflight_endpoint, check_pricing, test_hypothesis, create_monitor, list_monitors, run_monitor_now, get_monitor_result, delete_monitor, generate_change_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
